dedupe_keys.name: global transportation demand dataset under the shared socioeconomic pathways

description: This dataset projects land-based passenger transport (passenger-kilometres) and freight transport (tonne- kilometres) by country under the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) scenario framework. It was built from historical ITF Transport Outlook data for passenger transport in 38 countries and freight in 43 countries from 1990 to 2018, socioeconomic variables from the World Bank World Development Indicators, and SSP projections from the IIASA database, and was used to study the drivers of transport energy demand. It is a single CSV of about 2 MB, deposited by Joan Nkiriki and Paulina Jaramillo (Carnegie Mellon University) with co-authors from Rochester Institute of Technology and Oxford. Coverage is global by country. Access: free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 (version v0, February 2021). Caveats: the authors assume that demand in developing countries tracks global average per-capita trends because disaggregated data were lacking, so they call the estimates indicative. It supports long-term capacity planning and climate scenario studies of transport demand, and complements the ITF transport statistics and the iTEM harmonised transport database catalogued here.
